label: Qwen Light Blend
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 + RunningHub's light & shadow blending LoRA: relights an object pasted into the plate so it sits in the scene - matching light, specular highlights, depth and a contact shadow. Output: the frame at plate size.
usage: Relights an object you pasted into the plate so it sits in the scene (light, highlights, contact shadow).
Feed the rough comp (object already over the background) into 'comp'.
Pick the frame with 'frame' (Set to current frame) - only that frame is sent.
Keep 'pengyu' first in the prompt (trigger word).
Crop: tick 'crop' and move the box in the viewer to send only that area (more detail on small fixes).
Comp the result back only around the object and its shadow.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.
License (checked 2026-11): Qwen Research License - research or evaluation only. Paid work needs a separate license from Qwen. This LoRA's own license is unconfirmed.

output.tooltip: Qwen works on display-referred images, so highlights are rolled off or clipped (see the highlights knob). It regenerates the frame - comp the result back only around the object and its shadow.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.default: pengyu Apply consistent lighting to the product or object, enhance specular highlights, front-back spatial relationship, add natural contact shadow, and blend it seamlessly into the background.
knobs.tooltip: Keep 'pengyu' first - it is the LoRA's trigger word. The plate is the rough comp (the object already placed over the background).

knobs.name: lora_strength
knobs.label: LoRA strength
knobs.tooltip: The card gives no recommended strength. Lower it if the background changes too much.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Pixel budget (aspect kept). 0 = the plate's own size; up to 2048 (use 2048 for 4K plates). The result is scaled back to plate size.

knobs.name: cfg
knobs.label: cfg
knobs.tooltip: Keep 1 (official). Raise it only together with a negative prompt.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.

knobs.name: negative_prompt
knobs.label: negative prompt
knobs.tooltip: Only used when cfg is above 1.
